what: Embraer is the Brazilian aircraft maker. It builds the E-Jet regional airliners, Phenom and Praetor business jets, the KC-390 military transport, and does defence and services work.
customers: Regional airlines, corporate jet buyers, and air forces including Brazil's and several European ones.
money: the KC-390 transport and A-29 light attack aircraft
parts and maintenance on the installed fleet
moat: Certified aircraft in a category Boeing and Airbus do not serve, and an installed fleet of thousands of regional jets that need parts and maintenance for decades.
risks: Pilot scope clauses in American airline contracts limit how large regional jets can be, which constrains E2 sales
A Brazilian cost base against dollar revenue, so the exchange rate moves the margin
33 times earnings on a 4.6% net margin
opportunities: Revenue grew from $4.2B to $7.6B in four years and the backlog is at a record
Analysts see about 34% upside, with 15 covering the stock
The KC-390 has been winning European orders, which turns defence into a real third business
watch: The order backlog and deliveries per year against guidance.
